tools.name: bigmarker_list_conferences
tools.description: List webinars and events from all channels the key can reach. Filter by type (future, past, happening_now ...), title text and a time range. Default type is future. API: GET /conferences/.

tools.name: bigmarker_get_conference
tools.description: Get one webinar or event by id: title, address, purpose, schedule and settings. API: GET /conferences/{id}.

tools.name: bigmarker_search_conferences
tools.description: Search conferences across all channels by title, a time range or a list of ids. Read-only. API: POST /conferences/search.

tools.name: bigmarker_list_channels
tools.description: List all channels (id, url, name, overview) the key can access. API: GET /channels/.

tools.name: bigmarker_get_channel
tools.description: Get one channel by id: url, name, overview and description. API: GET /channels/{id}.

tools.name: bigmarker_list_channel_conferences
tools.description: List the conferences of one channel with registration and attendance totals (registrations, live attendees, on-demand viewers). API: GET /channels/{channel_url}/conferences/stats.

tools.name: bigmarker_list_registrations
tools.description: List the people registered for a conference: name, email, personal enter URL and certificate state. Use include_all_status to also see canceled or pending ones. Personal data. API: GET /conferences/registrations/{id}.

tools.name: bigmarker_list_attendees
tools.description: List who attended a conference live, with enter and leave times, duration, chat, Q&A and poll counts. Personal data. API: GET /conferences/{id}/attendees.

tools.name: bigmarker_list_no_shows
tools.description: List registrants who did not attend the conference, with registration date, country and traffic source. Personal data. API: GET /reporting/conferences/no_shows/{id}.

tools.name: bigmarker_get_event_summary
tools.description: Get the summary report of a conference: total live minutes watched, creator and creation date. API: GET /reporting/conferences/event_summary/{id}.

tools.name: bigmarker_list_presenters
tools.description: List the presenters of a conference: name, email, display settings and page URL. API: GET /conferences/{id}/presenters.

tools.name: bigmarker_get_recording
tools.description: Get the recording status of a conference. API: GET /conferences/{id}/recording.

tools.name: bigmarker_list_recording_views
tools.description: List the on-demand views of a conference recording: registrant id, time and minutes watched. API: GET /conferences/{id}/recording_views.

tools.name: bigmarker_register_user
tools.description: WRITE: register a person for a conference. BigMarker may send the person a confirmation email. Returns the personal URL the person uses to enter. API: PUT /conferences/register.

tools.name: bigmarker_cancel_registration
tools.description: WRITE: cancel the registration of one person for a conference. Returns the registration id and its new status. API: POST /conferences/cancel_registration.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bigmarker_search_conferences, bigmarker_list_channels, bigmarker_get_channel, bigmarker_list_registrations, bigmarker_list_attendees, bigmarker_list_presenters · Public sink: bigmarker_search_conferences, bigmarker_list_registrations, bigmarker_list_presenters, bigmarker_register_user, bigmarker_cancel_registration.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bigmarker_search_conferences, bigmarker_list_channels, bigmarker_get_channel, bigmarker_list_registrations, bigmarker_list_attendees, bigmarker_list_presenters · Public sink: bigmarker_search_conferences, bigmarker_list_registrations, bigmarker_list_presenters, bigmarker_register_user, bigmarker_cancel_registration

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
